items.source: This generator is automatically applied when a field of type UUID is annotated with @Id and @GeneratedValue.
items.translation: 当类型为UUID的字段被标注为@Id和@GeneratedValue时，会自动应用此生成器。

items.source: This annotation indicates a persistent property that is composed of multiple properties on a node or relationship.
items.translation: 此注释表示一个由节点或关系上的多个属性组成的persistent property。

items.source: This annotation can be used on a field of type Collection<String>.
items.translation: 此注解可用于类型为 Collection<String> 的字段。

items.source: This IdGenerator does nothing.
items.translation: 此IdGenerator不执行任何操作。

items.source: A combined annotation for id fields in RelationshipProperties classes.
items.translation: 用于 `RelationshipProperties` 类中 id 字段的组合注解。

items.source: Marks an entity in a RelationshipProperties as the target node.
items.translation: 在 RelationshipProperties 中标记一个实体为目标节点。

items.source:
This package contains the schema that is defined by a set of classes, representing
nodes and relationships and their properties. It provides Neo4js main annotations to
mark classes as persistable nodes.
items.translation: 该包包含由一组类定义的架构，这些类代表节点、关系及其属性。它提供 Neo4j 的主要注解，用于将类标记为可持久化的节点。

items.source:
This package contains the core infrastructure for creating an
imperative or reactive client that can execute queries.
items.translation: 该包提供了创建可执行查询的指令式或响应式客户端的核心基础设施。

items.source: Provides a set of simples types that SDN supports.
items.translation: 提供了一组 SDN 支持的简单类型。

items.source: The main mapping framework.
items.translation: 主要映射框架。

items.source:
This package provides a couple of support classes that might be
helpful in your domain, for example a predicate indicating that some transaction may be
retried and additional converters and id generators.
items.translation: 该包提供了一些可能对您领域有帮助的支持类，例如指示某些事务可重试的谓词，以及额外的转换器和 ID 生成器。

items.source:
Contains the core infrastructure for translating unmanaged Neo4j
transaction into Spring managed transactions.
items.translation: 包含将未管理的 Neo4j 事务转换为 Spring 管理事务的核心基础设施。

items.source:
The default implementation, passing map properties through as they are on the way
to the graph and possibly applying a post processor on the way out of the graph.
items.translation: 默认实现会将图属性原样传递至图，并在离开图时可能应用后处理器。

items.source: The default operation for transforming the keys.
items.translation: 转换键的默认操作。

items.source: Phase of the mapping currently taking place.
items.translation: 当前映射所处的阶段。

items.source: Indicates a generated id.
items.translation: 表示生成的 ID。

items.source: This annotation is included here for completeness.
items.translation: 此处包含此注释以作完整。

items.source: Interface for generating ids for entities.
items.translation: 用于生成实体 ID 的接口。

items.source:
The annotation to configure the mapping from a node with a given set of labels to a
class and vice versa.
items.translation: 用于配置从具有给定标签集合的节点到类的映射，以及反向映射的注释。

items.source:
Informs SDN that the method annotated with this should be run once the object is loaded
from the database and fully hydrated.
items.translation: 通知 SDN，应在此注解标记的方法在对象从数据库加载并完全水合后运行。

items.source: The annotation to configure the mapping from a property to an attribute and vice versa.
items.translation: 用于配置属性与属性之间双向映射的注解。

items.source: Annotation to configure mappings of relationship.
items.translation: 用于配置关系映射的注解。

items.source: Enumeration of the direction a relationship can take.
items.translation: 枚举关系可采取的方向。

items.source:
This marker interface is used on classes to mark that they represent additional
relationship properties.
items.translation: 此标记接口用于在类上标记它们表示额外的关系属性。

items.source: Michael J. Simons
items.translation: 迈克尔·J·西蒙斯
